items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-15
items.q: The transcript introduces Dick Allen as the interviewer ('I'm Dick Allen') and asks questions to Jerry Blumberg. There is no mention of a personal or professional relationship between Jerry Blumberg and Dick Allen beyond the interview context.

ctx.x: That's Bill Russell said that, and I'm Dick Allen. Okay. And I'm going to ask Jerry a lot of questions about Bunk Johnson and his style since you took lessons from him. That's the thing I'd like for you to summarize again is the things that characterize Bunk style more than anything else. I know that's hard to put into words you said on the last day, but I thought maybe you'd had some more thoughts since the last time. Don't let me interrupt you.
Don't forget about Dizzy style. Don't forget to introduce Bunk .
